subject: Post-incident evidence handling: retention window and regional handback procedure
messages:
From: Sophie Nguyen <sophie.nguyen@acme.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on post-incident logs and regional deletion windows

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the quick help during yesterday's degraded inference event. Our incident review surfaced a couple of questions about the artifacts you provided:

- What is Redwood's retention window for the KV/cache traces and request logs you pulled for the forensics archive?
- We operate under EU data residency rules for some tenants — can you confirm whether any records in the archive contain EU-resident user identifiers and whether those will be segregated or redacted before handback?
- Finally, we need a clear timeline for when Redwood will remove all pre-handoff copies from its temporary forensic stores.

Sincerely,
Sophie
SRE, Acme Corp

(Attached: sample_request_ids.txt)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Nguyen <sophie.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on post-incident logs and regional deletion windows

Sophie —

Short answers up front:
- Retention: we keep the extracted forensic bundle in an encrypted, access-controlled S3 bucket for 30 days by default for handoff/analysis, unless you request a shorter window.
- Residency: bundles are tagged by region; by default we do not include EU PII in the handoff bundle — we can produce a redacted copy or provide a region-scoped extract.
- Deletion: temporary copies are scheduled for secure deletion 7 days after handoff completion unless you instruct otherwise; we can shorten to 48 hours if required in writing.

I'll loop in Rishi (Security) and Marcus (Forensics) to confirm the technical steps and the manifest format.

Best,
Olga
Sr. Incident Response Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: sample_request_ids.txt

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on post-incident logs and regional deletion windows

Olga / team —

Confirming the technical posture from Security:

- We create a single forensic bundle per incident run (name: acme_incident_kv_logs_YYYYMMDD.tar.gz). That bundle is encrypted with a customer-scoped KMS key and stored in a restricted bucket.
- We tag records with a residency attribute (region: us/eu/apac) at ingest time. When creating a handoff bundle for a customer with mixed residency, we can either:
  * Produce a regional-sliced bundle (EU data excluded from the US bundle), or
  * Provide a redacted handoff where EU-identifiers are hashed and logged in the manifest.
- Default retention in our forensic store is 30 days post-bundle-creation; operational copies (temp mounts for analysis) are removed after 7 days post-handoff.

If Acme requests urgent deletion of all Redwood-held copies after handoff we require a signed request on company letterhead to trigger a full deletion workflow and chain-of-custody entry.

Rishi
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Cc: incident@firebreaksec.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Thanks — that helps. Quick follow-ups:

1) We need an EU-only extract containing request-level metadata (no full request bodies) for our compliance team. Can you confirm the exact fields included and provide an ETA for the extract?
2) For the timeline: Acme prefers deletion of all Redwood-held copies within 48 hours after we confirm receipt. We'll provide a signed request if that's required.

Also copying Firebreak Security to coordinate the handoff and validation.

Thanks,
Sophie
SRE, Acme Corp

From: incident@firebreaksec.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, sophie.nguyen@acme.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination for Acme EU extract and validation

Hi all —

Firebreak will validate the extract contents and confirm no EU-identifying fields are present in the US bundle. Suggested minimal field set for the EU-only extract:
- timestamp
- request_id
- model_name
- client_region
- response_latency_ms

We do not need request payloads or full prompt text for compliance validation. Please provide the extract as a compressed CSV and include a manifest.csv that lists per-file residency tags and the SHA256 checksums.

We can perform validation within 24 hours of receiving the extract.

Regards,
Amit Patel
Lead Incident Responder, Firebreak Security

(Referenced: validation playbook link: https://firebreaksec.com/playbooks/redwood-acme-validate)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Nguyen <sophie.nguyen@acme.com>, incident@firebreaksec.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on post-incident logs and regional deletion windows

Sophie / Team —

Plan and deliverables:

1) EU-only extract: we'll produce a compressed CSV containing the following fields: timestamp, request_id, model_name, client_region, response_latency_ms. No prompt/response bodies will be included. ETA: 2026-05-21 14:00 UTC.

2) Manifest & checksums: manifest CSV with per-file residency tags and SHA256. Included as forensic_manifest_20260520.csv.

3) Handoff: we will upload the two files to a pre-shared S3 location and send a short-term presigned URL (48-hour validity) to Sophie and Firebreak.

4) Deletion policy: upon your signed deletion request we will run the full deletion workflow. By default we will:
   - Remove temporary analysis mounts immediately after handoff (within 2 hours).
   - Mark the forensic bundle for deletion and remove from active buckets within 48 hours post-handoff.
   - Purge any replicated copies per our cross-region policy within 30 days (we will not attempt cross-region purge without a signed request for expedited removal).

5) Evidence integrity: attachments will include a manifest and checksums; we will provide a short chain-of-custody note in the bucket metadata.

Attachments to follow: acme_incident_kv_logs_20260518.tar.gz (encrypted) and forensic_manifest_20260520.csv (manifest). Please reply to confirm you accept the fields and timeline. Once we have your signed deletion request we'll schedule the 48-hour deletion.

Thanks,
Olga
Sr. Incident Response Manager
Redwood Inference
